settings.heading: Shade, made to measure.
settings.text: Size it to the centimetre, pick a finish and see the price before anyone calls you back. Motorised louvres open to the sun and close against the rain.

settings.lead: Enter the size of your terrace. We manufacture in standard frame bands and cut to your exact size, so the price you see is the price you pay.
settings.delivery_note: Made to order in 3–4 weeks. Delivered on a pallet, installed in a day.

settings.heading: Built like architecture, not furniture.
settings.text: Extruded 6063-T6 aluminium, hidden gutters in every beam and a rain sensor that closes the roof before the first drop lands on your sofa.

settings.heading: From terrace to shade in five weeks.
settings.text: One coordinator from order to handover. You'll know the install date before production starts.
settings.note:
• A level, solid base: paving, decking on joists or a concrete pad.
  • A 230 V outdoor socket within 5 m of a post.
  • Clear access for two installers and a pallet.

settings.title: Order & deposit
settings.text: Your exact size and finish are locked, with a 30% deposit.

settings.title: Site survey
settings.text: A surveyor confirms the base, fixings and power, or sends you a 10-minute photo checklist.

settings.title: Made to order
settings.text: Profiles are cut, powder-coated and pre-wired in our workshop.

settings.title: Installed in a day
settings.text: Two certified installers fit, wire and commission it, then walk you through the controls.

settings.heading: Before you order
settings.text: Planning questions, answered by the people who install them.

settings.question: Why is my pergola priced at a larger size?
settings.answer: Frames are manufactured in standard bands (every metre) and cut to your exact size. You pay the band price; the exact size travels with your order.

settings.question: Do I need planning permission?
settings.answer: In many areas a free-standing pergola under 3 m high is permitted development, but rules vary. We include a planning checklist with every quote.

settings.question: Can I install it myself?
settings.answer: Yes, if you're comfortable with anchors and a 230 V connection. Untick installation and we'll ship it with a step-by-step guide and video call support.

settings.question: What happens in heavy rain or snow?
settings.answer: The rain sensor closes the louvres automatically. Water runs through hidden gutters and down the posts. Closed, the roof carries 150 kg/m² of snow.

settings.question: What does the warranty cover?
settings.answer: 10 years on the frame and coating, 5 years on the motor and electronics, 2 years on fabric screens.
